# `dist/` — generated download artifacts (not part of the paper)

The working packages live in `PAPER_PROJECT/packages/`, which is **gitignored by design** (they are
regenerable). This folder holds the one build that was published so it can be downloaded by a direct link.

| File | Size | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `RESEARCH_PROJECT_FINAL_2026-10-03.zip` | 37,946,120 B (37.9 MB) | `RESEARCH_PROJECT_FINAL.zip` built by `PAPER_PROJECT/00_Project_Control/make_packages.py final` on 2026-10-03 from commit `7bad2dd` of branch `arena/01a10176-le` — the whole `PAPER_PROJECT/` tree (523 files) plus `MANIFEST.json` with a SHA-256 per file |
| `RESEARCH_PROJECT_FINAL_2026-10-03.zip.sha256` | 109 B | `sha256sum` of the archive: `98bfbc542eba5ef5dd32dbad7ecb2e3d9c2649b12bbf7a4cd0192b0a8b79732e` |

Contents at a glance: `00_Project_Control` (control + `DECISION_LOG` incl. P13-D002), `01_Literature`
(54 Crossref-verified references), `02`–`05` (acceptance criteria, validation, theory, numerical method),
`06_Source_Code` (solver + all four code-freeze manifests, incl. the deposited
`CODE_FREEZE_submission_2026_10_03.json`), `07_Tests`, `08_Experiments`, `09_Raw_Data` (150 production runs
as `.npz`/`.json` pairs + convergence), `10_Processed_Data`, `11_Figures`, `12_Tables`,
`13_Manuscript` (`.md`/`.docx`/`.pdf`, `FINAL_REVISED_MANUSCRIPT.tex/.pdf`,
`FINAL_REVISED_CALCULATIONS.tex/.pdf`, `.bib`, highlights, cover letter, supplementary tables, QA report),
`14_Documentation`, `15_Audits`.

Verify after downloading:

```bash
sha256sum -c RESEARCH_PROJECT_FINAL_2026-10-03.zip.sha256
unzip -l RESEARCH_PROJECT_FINAL_2026-10-03.zip | tail -1        # 524 entries (523 files + MANIFEST.json)
```

Rebuild it (byte-for-byte reproducible except the timestamps recorded in `MANIFEST.json`):

```bash
python3 PAPER_PROJECT/00_Project_Control/make_packages.py final
cp PAPER_PROJECT/packages/RESEARCH_PROJECT_FINAL.zip dist/
```

A whole-repository snapshot (this branch, including `work/`, `tools/`, `docs/` and the delivered `le.zip`,
~96 MB, generated by GitHub on demand) is at
<https://github.com/vipin-oss/le/archive/refs/heads/arena/01a10176-le.zip>.
`main` equivalent: <https://github.com/vipin-oss/le/archive/refs/heads/main.zip>.
